name: salon-saas
description: Dart Smart Salon - multi-tenant salon management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:website"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix website
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix website && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix website && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix frontend && npm run format --prefix backend
